final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 4]; rule=the device turns on when object 0 is on the device along with exactly one of objects 1, 2, or 4.
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 3, object 5]; rule=the device turns on if object 4 is present and objects 3 and 5 are absent.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4, object 7]; rule=object 1 must be present and objects 4 and 7 must not be present
Announce: relevant=[object 2]; rule=the device turns on if object 2 is present and all other objects are either object 0 or have numbers not divisible by 3
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=the device turns on if object 3 is included and neither object 4 nor object 5 is included

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1]; rule=the device is on if (object 0 is present and object 1 is not present) or (object 0 is not present, the sum of the numbers is even, and at least one object has an odd number).
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 5, object 7]; rule=device turns on when object 0 is present with exactly one of objects 4, 5, or 7 (other objects may be present or absent).
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 0, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if object 4 is present and neither object 0 nor object 6 are on the device.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 3, object 4]; rule=exactly one of object 1, object 3, or object 4 must be present
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 3, object 5]; rule=The device turns on if object 2 is included and neither object 3 nor object 5 are in the set.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 6, object 7]; rule=object 1 must be present and objects 6 and 7 must not be present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6]; rule=The device turns on when object 0 is present and both object 4 and object 6 are absent.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=the device turns on if exactly one of object 0, 1, or 2 is present in the set.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if object 0 is alone, or exactly two objects are placed: (a) object 0 with another object whose number is not 1 or 4, or (b) two non-zero objects that are consecutive numbers or differ by 2.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=device turns on when the sum of the numbers of the objects on it is a prime number or an even number

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=the device turns on if (object 4 is present and neither object 0 nor object 1 is present) OR (exactly one of object 0 or object 1 is present and object 4 is not present)
